recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Do not change Composition.category from example to preferred under FHIR-7428; any future binding-strength change should be a new work-group decision because category has evolved separately since DSTU1.
issue_request: FHIR-7428 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Structured Documents request to allow SNOMED CT codes for Composition typecodes. Its resolution said .type and .class should not force LOINC and asked for a comment noting that LOINC is ubiquitous, strongly endorsed by the work group, and often required by implementation guides as an extensible binding.
initial_application: SVN revision 6198, now git commit d69e59071c85aff8e7d5d104188c39f911f4d6f4, explicitly applied FHIR-7428 by adding the LOINC endorsement comment to the Composition.type spreadsheet source. Same-cycle FHIR-8057/SVN 5993 work changed the Composition DocumentType binding to preferred and kept DocumentClass as an example binding with a LOINC document-kind value set.
additional_context: Composition remains active in the current build. The old Composition.class element is now Composition.category; later issues including FHIR-17171, FHIR-32577, FHIR-24671, and FHIR-31668 renamed/refined category semantics, broadened the value set to referenced-item-category, and retained example binding treatment. Those later decisions make a FHIR-7428-driven category preferred-binding edit inappropriate.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative Composition.type source is preferred-bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/doc-typecodes and carries the LOINC guidance note, satisfying the seed's SNOMED CT allowance without disturbing later category decisions.
